description: The painting is a tiered stage of dark steps covered in brass instruments (trumpets, trombones, a sousaphone, drums) and empty gold and magenta varsity-style jackets set out on the risers. A dusk sky, distant mountains, a dense dark crowd, stage truss and spotlights frame it, with banners on poles at the top. No legible text, no frame and no people in the foreground.
